method: Ridge regression on his 438 grades (A+=5..F=0) using shrunk series, developer, genre, era and platform-genre averages, years since release and LaunchBox crowd stars (shown raw as 'community'; for delta converted to his scale by percentile rank, so the crowd's Nth-percentile game = his Nth-percentile grade), with grade cutoffs set to his own A/B/C mix.
insights: Crowd rates his games 4.0/5 on average; he grades them a flat B
Fighting games: 1.3 grades below the crowd. MK II got an F.
Sims, strategy and builders: half a grade kinder than the crowd
Kojima Productions: 6 games, avg A, a full grade over the crowd
Nintendo: avg A-, yet half a grade under the crowd's hype
PS5 games: half a grade harsher than the crowd
Played at launch: avg B+. Played 20+ years late: avg B-
'Clunky' in a review = never above a B (14 for 14)
Mentions checkpoints? 11 of those 14 reviews end in a C
Backlog forecast: 2 A+, 64 A, 275 B, 186 C, 8 D
